description: This bar chart compares the perplexity values for two pruning strategies—“Per-Output” (blue bars) and “Per-Layer” (orange bars)—across a range of sparsity rates from 10% to 80%, with the x-axis labeled “Sparsity Rate” and the y-axis labeled “Perplexity” on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3. The bars are grouped by sparsity rate, with each group containing one blue bar and one orange bar, and are arranged in ascending order of sparsity rate from left to right. At every sparsity rate, both bars are approximately equal in height, with the Per-Output bar being slightly shorter than the Per-Layer bar. For instance, at 10% sparsity, both bars are approximately 10^1 (10), at 20% sparsity, both are approximately 10^1 (10), at 30% sparsity, both are approximately 10^1 (10), at 40% sparsity, both are approximately 10^1 (10), at 50% sparsity, both are approximately 10^1 (10), at 60% sparsity, both are approximately 10^1 (10), at 70% sparsity, both are approximately 10^1 (10), and at 80% sparsity, both are approximately 10^3 (1000). There are no visual annotations or emphasis on any specific bar.
